name: Flame Detector Mounting Bracket (Optional)

subcategory.name: Analogue Addressable Duct, Flame, Beam & Aspirating Detectors

summary: The Flame Detector Bracket is an optional accessory for the Intelligent Flame Detectors. It is a stainless-steel mounting bracket adjustable in two axis. Not suitable for Base Mounted Flame Detectors. This bracket allows the flame detectors of Context Plus to be mounted in any orientation.
